quick_facts.sprint_goal: System is production-ready: Docker Compose verified for production deployment, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline live, Swagger/OpenAPI complete, and onboarding guide tested by a new team member end-to-end.

content.tldr: Final hardening sprint. No new features. Production Docker config, CI/CD pipeline, API documentation, and onboarding verification. System exits this sprint as a deployable product.

features_committed.title: Production Docker & Deployment
features_committed.rationale: Development docker-compose works but production requires secrets management, resource limits, and health monitoring.
tasks: T127: docker-compose.prod.yml — production overrides: no volume bind mounts, resource limits, restart: always, no pgAdmin
T128: Backend Dockerfile: multi-stage build, NODE_ENV=production, no devDependencies in final image
T129: Frontend Dockerfile: verify nginx config serves SPA correctly (try_files fallback for react-router)
T130: Secrets management: verify all secrets via environment variables (no hardcoded values in any Dockerfile or compose)
T131: Health check endpoints verified: GET /health (backend), nginx 200 (frontend, wiki-app)
T133: Deployment runbook written in wiki/onboarding.json 'production-checklist' section

features_committed.title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
features_committed.rationale: Manual deployment is error-prone. CI ensures tests run on every PR and main branch is always deployable.
tasks: T134: .github/workflows/ci.yml — on: push to develop + PR to main
T135: CI steps: checkout → install deps → tsc --noEmit → vitest run → playwright test (headless)
T136: CI: docker compose build (no push) to verify build integrity
T137: Backend unit tests in CI: 36+ tests green gate
T138: Branch protection: PR to main requires CI passing

features_committed.title: Swagger / OpenAPI Completeness
features_committed.rationale: API documentation must be complete for any future integration partners or frontend developer handoff.
tasks: T139: Audit all controllers for missing @ApiOperation, @ApiResponse, @ApiBearerAuth decorators
T140: Add missing decorators to orders, invoices, reporting controllers
T141: Verify swagger.json snapshot in docs/ — update with current API shape
T142: Document auth flow in Swagger: @ApiBearerAuth used on all protected endpoints

definition_of_done.gate_1_build: tsc --noEmit clean, vite build clean, docker compose build succeeds
definition_of_done.gate_2_tests: All Vitest unit tests green (36+ backend, frontend coverage >70%)
definition_of_done.gate_3_e2e: All Playwright E2E scenarios green (Sprint 12 suites)
definition_of_done.gate_5_deploy: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up → system accessible at :80, :3001
definition_of_done.gate_6_onboarding: A developer unfamiliar with the project can follow wiki/onboarding.json and run the system in < 30 minutes
definition_of_done.gate_7_ci: GitHub Actions CI pipeline green on main branch

out_of_scope: Kubernetes deployment (post-production — Docker Compose sufficient for initial store scale)
External tax authority portal API integration (legal/operational dependency — post-production)
prerequisites: Sprint 12: E2E tests green, security audit passed
All sprints 4-11: features complete and stable

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 13 planned. Final production hardening sprint. Docker prod config + CI/CD + Swagger + onboarding verification. Exit criteria: fully deployable product.
